objectives.description: Bootstrap specs/errors.json; regenerate deploy tree; verify/repair the known deploy-mechanism gap; run verify-deploy.sh and deployed test suite; end-to-end /errors check with throwaway record lifecycle; confirm both live readers; run final gate set; confirm no hand-authored .claude/** files

deviations.description: Verify the known deploy-mechanism gap did not bite
deviations.reason: The gap DID bite: .claude/scripts/tests/test-errors-append.sh failed to deploy via deploy-headless.sh (run twice, idempotently missing both times), while errors-append.sh/errors-schema.json/errors-format.md deployed correctly. Root-caused via a headless-nvim probe: sync.scan_all_artifacts's incremental 'Sync all' scan path returns zero is_subdir=true entries for the scripts category -- it does not recurse into scripts/tests/ or scripts/lib/ at all, a broader gap than 'brand-new file only' (already-deployed tests/*.sh and lib/*.sh files are equally unreachable by this scan path). Applied the documented one-off loader-primitive workaround: invoked loader.copy_scripts(manifest, source_dir, target_dir, protected_paths) directly via headless nvim luafile, which correctly handles subdirectory entries. Re-verified all four files byte-identical to source store post-workaround.
